setup: The triangle has sides [[a]], [[b]] and [[c]], and no angle is given.

steps.say: Three sides fix a triangle, so its area is determined even though no height is given. Heron's formula reaches it through the semiperimeter $s$: $A = \sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}$.
The semiperimeter is half the perimeter, and that single number is what lets the three sides be used without choosing a base. The four factors multiply to a perfect square, and its root is [[value]].
